name: i9_11900kf_rtx3080ti
_note: UNCALIBRATED PRIOR built from public specifications and assumptions, not from measurements on this machine. Run `python -m benchmarks.profile_hardware --template <this profile>` and `python -m benchmarks.run_llama_bench` on the machine to replace it.

devices.name: host
devices._comment: Intel i9-11900KF (8 cores, AVX-512). Assumed: dual-channel DDR4-3200 at 0.7 of its 51.2 GB/s theoretical bandwidth, 64 GiB installed (set to the installed amount), and 60 GMAC/s for INT4 kernels, chosen so that CPU-only decoding of a dense 7-8B model is limited by memory bandwidth (as is commonly reported for llama.cpp on desktop CPUs) rather than by arithmetic. The compute rate is the least certain number here; calibration step 1 replaces it.

devices.name: gpu
devices._comment: NVIDIA RTX 3080 Ti, 12 GB. Assumed: 500 GB/s effective memory bandwidth for quantised kernels, 17 TMAC/s, 3 us kernel launch.
